title: The Old Man's Last Wish
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji stepped through the first stone gate of Chen Xuan's ruins, and the scene before him made his pupils contract sharply—not the legendary treasure hall, but an underground tomb where tens of thousands of coffins were neatly arranged in perfect rows.

text.content: The old wandering cultivator's body trembled slightly in the cold wind, blood spilling from the corner of his mouth and crystallizing into dark red ice on his pale beard. His turbid eyes stared fixedly at Chen Ji, as if wanting to carve the young man's face into the depths of his soul. "Chen Xuan's ruins lie beneath Sunset Cliff outside Qingzhou City... the entrance only appears during every full moon..." His voice was like a dying candle in the wind,，随时可能熄灭.

dialogue.content: "Old senior, don't speak. Let me channel a breath of True Qi to stabilize your injuries—" As Chen Ji spoke and reached out his hand, the old man's withered fingers tightly gripped his wrist.

"No need... My lifespan is already exhausted... even the Great Luo Immortal couldn't save me now..." The old man's voice suddenly became calm. "Within Chen Xuan's ruins lies everything Chen Xuan left behind, including... the truth of the Tianji Record's shackles. Those on the list from ten thousand years ago were all chess pieces selected by the Eye of Heavenly Dao... Their fate was written from the moment they were born."

text.content: Chen Ji felt his heart contract sharply. The truth of the Tianji Record's shackles—he had always wanted to know why the more complete the Tianji Record became, the stronger the deadly backlash of fate. Mo Xiansheng had never answered this question directly, only repeatedly emphasizing that "the time wasn't right." But now, a dying man was about to tell him the answer.

dialogue.content: "This old man surnames Zhou, given name Yuan... Ten thousand years ago, Chen Xuan discovered that the Tianji Record was not some ancient secret treasure, but the largest chess piece placed by the Eye of Heavenly Dao in this world." A trace of recollection flashed in the old man's eyes. "Every holder of the Tianji Record would be slowly devoured of their fortune by the Eye of Heavenly Dao until they became its puppet. And Chen Xuan... was the only person who attempted to resist."

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. Zhou Yuan's words formed some kind of echo with Mo Xiansheng's ten-thousand-year vigil—could that guardian always hiding within the first fragment's remnant soul also be waiting for someone capable of breaking the shackles? He remembered the bone-deep weakness he felt after each use of the Tianji Record, and Mo Xiansheng's words: "No holder of the Tianji Record has ever met a good end."

dialogue.content: "What did Chen Xuan discover in the ruins? Did he find a way to break the shackles?" Chen Ji's voice was low, but his gaze burned intensely as he stared at the old man.

"He found it... but the cost was too great." A wisp of black blood溢出了老者的嘴角. "Chen Xuan discovered that to break the shackles, one must gather nine Heavenly Fate artifacts to fully awaken the Tianji Record. And the guardian of each artifact... was a former Tianji Record holder whose memory was erased by the Eye of Heavenly Dao and reborn."

text.content: Chen Ji felt浑身发冷. Nine Heavenly Fate artifacts, nine former holders with erased memories—this meant his fate had long been written, and the so-called "resistance against the shackles" was merely another layer of deeper calculation? He unconsciously gripped the Tianji Record fragment tighter, that familiar warmth now feeling particularly scalding.

dialogue.content: "Young friend... You are a descendant of Chen Xuan, this old man can sense the bloodline flowing within you." The old man suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a sense of relief. "Chen Xuan left something in the deepest part of the ruins, his final hope for his descendants. But this old man couldn't reach that place. Today I pass this diagram to you, hoping you will... fulfill this old man's unfinished wish."

"Senior Zhou..." Chen Ji watched the fading light in the old man's eyes, feeling an indescribable sourness in his heart. This old man he had never met had given his entire life for a promise made ten thousand years ago, ultimately entrusting his hope to a stranger. "I, Chen Ji, hereby swear—I will definitely enter Chen Xuan's ruins, uncover the truth of the list from ten thousand years ago, and complete Senior's unfinished cause."

text.content: A relieved smile appeared on the old man's face. He raised his trembling hand, as if wanting to touch Chen Ji's face once more, but stopped halfway in the air. "This old man's greatest regret in this life... is not witnessing the fulfillment of Lord Chen Xuan's wish..." His voice grew lower and lower. "Young friend, remember... your sister... she is not the Heavenly Fate Lock Key... she is..."

Before he could finish speaking, the old man's body suddenly stiffened. His turbid eyes widened abruptly, as if remembering something of utmost importance, but he could no longer utter any sound. Chen Ji watched the light in those eyes dimming bit by bit, his fingers unconsciously tightening around the map fragment. His sister is not the Heavenly Fate Lock Key? Then what is she? What has happened during all these years she was taken away by the Holy Sect?

The cold wind howled past, and the old man's body began to wither at a visible speed, as if some force was drawing away his last vitality. Chen Ji silently watched all this, but his heart churned with mighty waves. Chen Xuan's ruins, the list from ten thousand years ago, the Heavenly Fate artifacts, his sister's true identity—all the mysteries pointed in the same direction. He took a deep breath and carefully stored the map fragment close to his body.

choice.prompt: Senior Zhou Yuan had passed on. Chen Ji stood in the cold wind, his thoughts turbulent. How should he proceed next?

choices.description: The ruins' entrance will appear on the night of the full moon. Time is pressing and cannot be delayed. Before other forces become aware, we should enter the ruins first.

choices.visible_reward: Seize the initiative, gain the upper hand in exploring the ruins

text.content: Chen Ji properly placed the old man's remains in a wind-sheltered ravine, building a simple grave with stacked stones. He deeply bowed before the grave and softly said: "Senior Zhou, your wish is recorded in my heart, Chen Ji. When I uncover the truth, I will definitely return to console your spirit in heaven." With that, he turned and set foot on the road to Qingzhou. In the twilight, that gaunt背影 appeared particularly lonely yet resolute.

choices.text: Return to Tianqing Sect to organize clues first
choices.description: The journey to the ruins is fraught with dangers. One should first return to the sect to use resources for in-depth study of the map fragment, while also trying to contact Ye Qing for intelligence support from the Demonic Path.
choices.visible_cost: Delay wastes time; other forces may get there first
choices.visible_reward: Gain more intelligence support and preparation work
choices.risk_hint: The old man's news may have already leaked. There are also hidden dangers within the sect.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't rush on his way. Instead, he found a hidden cave nearby. He sat cross-legged, taking out the Tianji Record fragment and map fragment for careful comparison. The runes on the fragment and the markings on the map subtly resonated with each other. Mo Xiansheng's familiar aged voice rang out in Chen Ji's mind: "You are finally going there... There lies the secret this old man has guarded for ten thousand years. Be careful. The trials within the ruins are more cruel than you can imagine."

choices.text: Attempt to use the Tianji Record to foresee the ruins
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record fragment to foresee information related to Chen Xuan's ruins within the next three hours. Although it will consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate, it may provide key intelligence.

choices.visible_reward: Gain key foresight information about the ruins' interior

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and sank his consciousness into the Tianji Record fragment. Familiar dizziness washed over him, and a blurry image appeared before his eyes—dark corridors, flickering will-o'-the-wisps, and a massive stone gate. However, whenever the image focused on the inscriptions on the stone gate, it became distorted and blurred, as if an invisible force was blocking it. He caught a glimpse of a woman's背影, but couldn't see her face clearly. Sister... Is she in the ruins?

Night fell. Chen Ji walked alone through the desolate mountains. The old man's dying words echoed endlessly in his mind—Chen Xuan's ruins, the truth of the Tianji Record's shackles, the list from ten thousand years ago, and that unfinished sentence: "Your sister is not the Heavenly Fate Lock Key." He thought of Chen Nian, who had been missing for years, the girl taken away by the Holy Sect. She had never appeared in his plans, yet now became the greatest variable.

Moonlight fell upon the mountain path. Chen Ji's footsteps suddenly halted. He took out the blood-stained map fragment from his chest and examined it carefully under the moonlight. The edges of the fragment were damaged, but the lines remained clearly discernible—it was an extremely intricate formation diagram, with every line corresponding to certain pathways of heavenly and earthly elemental energy flow. Chen Xuan... What was this ancestor of his trying to tell his descendants?

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji... What are you thinking?" Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly came from the fragment, carrying a meaningful tone. "Did the old man's death shake you?"

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, the corners of his mouth slightly lifting. Shake him? No, he had never wavered. Zhou Yuan's death only made him understand one thing more clearly—in this chess game controlled by the Eye of Heavenly Dao for ten thousand years, no one could remain uninvolved. Rather than passively waiting for fate's arrangement, he would actively enter the chess game and become the one who overturns the board. "Mo Xiansheng, you have guarded the Tianji Record for so long. Were you also waiting for someone capable of breaking the shackles?"

dialogue.content: "..." Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment. His voice carried a trace of fluctuation for the first time. "The person this old man was waiting for has finally arrived. In the deepest part of the ruins lies Chen Xuan's final legacy. It will tell you everything. But before that, you need to pass three trials to prove yourself worthy of inheriting his mantle."

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the fragment back into his chest, his gaze fixed on Qingzhou's direction in the distance. There were still three days until the full moon night, enough time for him to make all preparations. "Chen Xuan's ruins..." he murmured softly, his eyes flashing with a resolute light. "Chen Ji has arrived." Just then, a faint sound of breaking through the air came from afar. A black shadow was rapidly approaching from the distance. Chen Ji's expression tensed, his body flickering as he concealed himself among the tree shadows. The visitor's aura... was somewhat familiar.

A moment later, a graceful figure descended beside a nearby pond. Under the moonlight, the person wore black纱衣, with a crimson dot between her brows. It was the Demonic Path Saintess Ye Qing. She looked around as if searching for something, then softly said: "Chen Ji, I know you're here. The Holy Sect has received news. Sunset Cliff ruins are about to become the center of a storm... I came to remind you of something." She paused, her voice dropping even lower. "Chen Nian... she is not at the Holy Sect. Three months ago, she disappeared from the Holy Sect."
